Home Projects About About Us Company Structure Corporate Social Responsibility Health and Safety Accreditations News Modern Slavery Contact People Leadership Careers Partners Company Policies Privacy Policy Fire Fire Detection and Alarms Fire Suppression High Sensitivity Smoke Detection Voice Alarm Systems Emergency Voice Communication System Public Address and Sound Amplification Fire Alarm Monitoring Integral Security Intruder Alarms Access Control CCTV AMAG Symmetry Lenel OnGuard Avigilon Alta Gates and Barriers IT Solutions IT Support IT Security IT Infrastructure Disaster Recovery and Business Continuity Structured Cabling Audio Visual Telephone Systems Data Centre Hot and Cold Aisle Systems R&M Managed Services Back Delivery of our first batch of brand-new electric ID Buzz vans We are proud to announce the delivery of our first batch of brand-new electric ID. Buzz vans. These state-of-the-art, fully electric vehicles represent a significant step forward in our journey towards a more sustainable future. At GBE Converge, we believe sustainability is not just a buzzword—it is a commitment. As we strive to reduce our carbon footprint, investing in eco-friendly solutions like these vans is crucial to aligning our operations with our environmental values. These vehicles will not only enhance our fleet but also demonstrate how innovation and responsibility can go hand in hand. Switching to electric is more than a transition; it is a transformation. Every mile driven in these ID. Buzz vans takes us closer to a cleaner, greener tomorrow. We are thrilled to lead by example in the drive toward sustainability and hope this inspires others to embrace change for the better. Next Copyright GBE
